name: james-heinrich/getid3
input_api: getID3::analyze(local tagged MP3 path); ID3v2 title/artist/album and major version
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, album, and major version
family: getID3 native MP3 and ID3v2 parser
family_note: Multi-format getID3 package; this adapter uses its own ID3v2 and MPEG audio parsers.

name: wapmorgan/mp3info
input_api: Mp3Info(local tagged MP3 path, parseTags=true); tags2 TIT2/TPE1/TALB and ID3v2 major version
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, album, and major version
family: Mp3Info native MP3 and ID3v2 parser
family_note: Own ID3v2.3 and MPEG audio parser; the pinned release README states that ID3v2.2 and v2.4 are unsupported.

name: christophwurst/id3parser
input_api: ID3Parser::analyze(local tagged MP3 path); ID3v2 comments title/artist/album and major version
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, album, and major version
family_note: This package vendors a stripped-down getID3 ID3 implementation; it is a separate package path, not an independent parser family. Packagist marks it abandoned in favor of nextcloud/id3parser.

name: owen-oj/laravel-getid3
input_api: GetId3(local tagged MP3 path); getTitle/getArtist/getAlbum and extractInfo ID3v2 major version
scope: ID3v2.3 title, artist, album, and major version
family: getID3 native MP3 and ID3v2 parser
family_note: Laravel wrapper delegates to the same pinned james-heinrich/getid3 package in this lock; a separate package path, not an independent parser family.

name: wapmorgan/media-file
input_api: MediaFile::open(local tagged MP3 path); isAudio and getAudio sample rate/bit rate
scope: MP3 audio type, 8 kHz sample rate, and 32 kb/s bit rate on an ID3v2.3-tagged control
family: Mp3Info native MP3 and ID3v2 parser
family_note: MediaFile wraps the pinned wapmorgan/mp3info parser in its isolated lock. This adapter exposes audio properties, not the tag text; it is a separate package path, not an independent parser family.

name: kiwilan/php-audio
family: getID3 native MP3 and ID3v2 parser
family_note: Audio delegates to james-heinrich/getid3 v1.9.22 in its isolated lock; this is a distinct wrapper package path but shares the getID3 parser family.

name: duncan3dc/meta-audio
input_api: Tagger::addDefaultModules(); Tagger::open(local tagged MP3 path); getTitle/getArtist/getAlbum
family_note: Own PHP ID3v2 module; the documented default-module setup is required. The ID3v2.4 control uses synchsafe frame sizes.
